description: I am honored to run for the Texas Fifth Court of Appeals,” said Judge Ben Smith. “The citizens of Dallas, Collin, Grayson, Kaufman, Rockwall, and Hunt Counties deserve appellate justices who uphold the law with integrity and clarity. My experience as a district judge and my commitment to fair, consistent rulings make me ready to serve on this esteemed court.”
paid_for_by: authorized by Judge Ben Smith for Justice, 5th Court of Appeals
title: Judge Ben Smith Launches Campaign for 5th Court of Appeals, Place 6
